name: amberRepublic
description: Shape Latvia's future in this political and economic simulation game. Make decisions as Latvia's leader with real data, painful trade-offs, and delayed consequences. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite.
highlights: Real data based on Latvia's 2025 statistics
Every decision has trade-offs with delayed consequences
Second-order effects model complex systemic dynamics
AI-powered event generation for unique playthroughs
